items.en: Everything that person says is just the official line. I want to hear what they really think.

items.qr: Kondo no watashitachi no konsaato no hihyou wa (___) kouhyou da.
items.en: The reviews of our latest concert are favourable on the whole.

one by one, in every detail

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.38, PDF 120). Book's notes (paraphrased): おしなべて = だいたい / おおむね / 概して (generally, on the whole). 選択肢の言葉: 3 逐一 = 一つ一つ (例: there is no need to report progress 逐一 (chikuichi) — just tell me the important points); 4 ひときわ = 一段と / 際立って (例: who is the beauty who ひときわ目立つ (hitokiwa medatsu) among all those women?). items.qr: Dantai kyougi de wa (___) ga nani yori juuyou da.
items.en: In team sports, teamwork matters more than anything.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.38, PDF 120). Book's notes (paraphrased): チームワーク = teamwork. 選択肢の言葉: 1 トーン (例: saying "this is a secret", she 声のトーンを落とした (koe no toon o otoshita)); 3 アナウンス (例: at stations, guidance アナウンスが流れている (anaunsu ga nagarete iru) all the time); 4 ネットワーク (例: the Internet is the best-known 通信ネットワーク (tsuushin nettowaaku)). items.q: 能力の高い人が会社で（ ）とは限らない。
items.qr: Nouryoku no takai hito ga kaisha de (___) to wa kagiranai.
items.en: Talented people don't necessarily get ahead in a company.

opts.en: move up to the next grade/class

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.38, PDF 120). Book's notes (paraphrased): 出世する = to be successful at work. 選択肢の言葉: 1 進級する = step up to a higher grade (例: students take a test when they 上のクラスに進級する (ue no kurasu ni shinkyuu suru)); 2 進出する = advance (例: the Japanese team kept winning and 決勝戦に進出した (kesshousen ni shinshutsu shita)); 4 上昇する = (数量が)上がる / 増える (例: last year 物価はわずかに上昇した (bukka wa wazuka ni joushou shita)).

items.q: 電力不足は国民にとって（ ）問題だ。
items.qr: Denryoku busoku wa kokumin ni totte (___) mondai da.
items.en: The power shortage is a pressing problem for the people of the country.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.38, PDF 120). Book's notes (paraphrased): 切実(な) = closely bound up with you and serious. 選択肢の言葉: 2 得がたい = 貴重(な), precious (例: two years of study abroad became 得がたい経験 (egatai keiken)); 4 切ない = sad and painful at heart (例: losing a friend is as 切ない (setsunai) as losing family). items.qr: Eki kara (___) go-fun inai to iu jouken no ie o sagashite imasu.
items.en: I'm looking for a house within five minutes' walk of the station.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.38–39, PDF 120–121). Book's notes (paraphrased): 徒歩 = walking, on foot. 選択肢の言葉: 1 歩幅 = 一歩の幅, length of one step (例: to run fast, training to 歩幅を広くする (hohaba o hiroku suru) works well); 2 歩行 = 歩くこと (例: the broken leg has healed well, so 歩行訓練 (hokou kunren) starts next week). items.en: This fruit doesn't look nice, but when you eat it, it is sweet and delicious.

the highlight, the part worth seeing

items.en: "Oomisoka" means the last day of the year.

items.q: 運転免許証を紛失してしまったので、（ ）を申請した。
items.qr: Unten menkyoshou o funshitsu shite shimatta node, (___) o shinsei shita.
items.en: I lost my driving licence, so I applied for a replacement.

opts.en: fresh recognition, coming to see anew

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.39, PDF 121). items.q: 近年、警察は飲酒運転をいっそう厳しく（ ）ようになった。
items.qr: Kinnen, keisatsu wa inshu unten o issou kibishiku (___) you ni natta.
items.en: In recent years the police have cracked down on drink-driving even more strictly.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.39, PDF 121). Book's notes (paraphrased): 取り締まる = watch over and restrict (control, regulate). 選択肢の言葉: 1 裁く = judge (例: there are views for and against the "lay judge system" in which citizens 罪人を裁く (zainin o sabaku)). The 別冊 has no notes for 2 監督する and 3 判断する. (added, not in book) The subject is 警察 and the object 飲酒運転 (an offence): police crack down on offences → 取り締まる. Courts 裁く;

items.q: 失敗の原因について（ ）としたが、だれも聞いてくれなかった。

items.en: I tried to explain myself about what caused the failure, but nobody would listen.

opts.en: make excuses, explain oneself (弁解する)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.39, PDF 121). Book's notes (paraphrased): 弁解する = make an excuse. 選択肢の言葉: 1 説教する = ① talk to teach a religion; ② talk to someone to guide or scold them (例: when they found out I had skipped school, 先生と親に説教された (sensei to oya ni sekkyou sareta)). items.qr: Orinpikku de no yuushou o hajime to shite, koko suunen no Tanaka senshu no katsuyaku ni wa (___) mono ga aru.
items.en: Starting with the Olympic win, Tanaka's performance over the last few years has been remarkable.

Book's notes (paraphrased): めざましい = remarkable. 選択肢の言葉: 1 あさましい = 情けない / みっともない / 心が卑しい (例: cheating old people out of money とは、あさましいことだ (to wa, asamashii koto da)); 3 たくましい = 力強い / タフな (例: it's a boy, so I want him to grow up たくましい子 (takumashii ko)); 4 おびただしい = 非常に多い (例: おびただしい数の人 (obitadashii kazu no hito) had gathered in the square). items.qr: Watashitachi no aida no gokai o toku tame ni, (___) hanashiaou ja nai ka.
items.en: Let's talk it through properly, to clear up the misunderstanding between us.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.40, PDF 122). Book's notes (paraphrased): とことん = どこまでも / 徹底的に. 選択肢の言葉: 1 たかだか = 多くても / せいぜい (例: a small used car would cost たかだか50万ぐらい (takadaka gojuuman gurai)); 2 ねほりはほり (根掘り葉掘り) = asking / checking everything down to small details (例: the police asked me 根掘り葉掘り (nehori hahori) what I did yesterday); 4 かれこれ = およそ (例: it is かれこれ10年 (karekore juunen) since my father died). items.en: This accident is believed to have been caused by some kind of fault in the train's wheels.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.40, PDF 122). items.qr: Hajimete no shokuba de (___) ita watashi ni, senpai ga yasashiku koe o kakete kureta.
items.en: When I was floundering at my first workplace, a senior colleague kindly spoke to me.

break off, be interrupted (途切れる)
be at a loss (まごつく)

items.qr: Kono kikai no (___) wa fukuzatsu da kara, koshou suru to yakkai da.
items.en: This machine's mechanism is complicated, so it's a real nuisance when it breaks down.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.41, PDF 123). Book's notes (paraphrased): 仕組み = structure, how something is put together. 選択肢の言葉: 1 用法 = 使い方 (例: this dictionary explains not only meanings but 用法 (youhou)); 3 参考: you do not say 機械の構成 — you say 機械の構造 (kikai no kouzou); 4 取り組み = an effort to solve a problem (例: エネルギー問題への取り組み (enerugii mondai e no torikumi) is a task for the whole world). items.qr: Daiji na bubun o motto kyouchou sureba, (___) no aru, ikiiki shita bunshou ni naru deshou.
items.en: If you stress the important parts more, your writing will have more light and shade and feel more alive.

Book's notes (paraphrased): めりはり = accent, stress (ups and downs). 選択肢の言葉: 1 けじめ = drawing a line, distinction (例: for a politician, 公私のけじめをきちんとつける (koushi no kejime o kichinto tsukeru) is only natural); 2 切れ目 = 区切り, a break (例: cars pass 切れ目なく (kireme naku) on this road, so crossing is dangerous). items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.42, PDF 124). Book's notes (paraphrased): チェック(する) = check. 選択肢の言葉: 1 コメント = comment (例: Minister, コメントを一言お願いします (komento o hitokoto onegai shimasu) on this issue); 2 キャッチ = catch, hear (例: where did you キャッチした (kyacchi shita) that information?); 4 ドリル = practice repeated many times (例: ドリルが効果的だ (doriru ga koukateki da) for improving arithmetic). The 別冊 has no note for 2 室内. (added, not in book) 3LDK describes the layout of a flat → 間取り. 部屋割り is for a trip or dormitor

items.q: 政府は新たなエネルギー対策を（ ）。
items.qr: Seifu wa arata na enerugii taisaku o (___).
items.en: The government has put forward new energy measures.

opts.en: took out; brought up (a topic) (持ち出す)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.72, PDF 154). Book's notes (paraphrased): 打ち出す = come up with, put forward. 選択肢の言葉: 2 持ち出す = ① take something from inside to outside (例: let's gather 非常時に持ち出すもの (hijouji ni mochidasu mono)) ② raise a topic (例: at dinner my wife 家を買う話を持ち出した (ie o kau hanashi o mochidashita)); 4 切り出す = ① cut stone or timber from a mountain and carry it out (例: this line was used to carry 山から切り出した材木 (y

items.q: 我が軍の資金はふんだんにある。
items.qr: Waga gun no shikin wa fundan ni aru.
items.en: Our side has funds in abundance.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.73, PDF 155). Book's notes (paraphrased): ふんだんに = たっぷり, more than can be used up. 選択肢の言葉: 1 若干 = an amount you cannot state exactly but which is not large / a little (例: 募集人数、若干名 (boshuu ninzuu, jakkan-mei) "a few positions open"; 先日提出した報告書を若干修正します (senjitsu teishutsu shita houkokusho o jakkan shuusei shimasu)); 3 おおまかに = roughly, dealing only with the main points (例: 当社の業務内容をおおまかにお
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第1回

items.q: 彼女のおせっかいにはうんざりだ。
items.qr: Kanojo no osekkai ni wa unzari da.
items.en: I am fed up with her meddling.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.73, PDF 155). Book's notes (paraphrased): おせっかい = 干渉, interfering in others' affairs unnecessarily. 選択肢の言葉: 1 無作法(な) = out of line with proper manners, impolite (例: あの人、無作法だから、好きになれないわ (ano hito, busahou da kara, suki ni narenai wa)); 3 説教／お説教 = ① a talk a religious leader gives to guide people (例: 日曜日は教会で牧師さんの説教を聞く (nichiyoubi wa kyoukai de bokushi-san no sekkyou o kiku)) ② a stiff
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第1回

items.q: 旅行のお土産はかさばらないものがいい。
items.qr: Ryokou no omiyage wa kasabaranai mono ga ii.
items.en: For travel souvenirs, things that aren't bulky are best.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.73, PDF 155). Book's notes (paraphrased): かさばる = large in bulk so it takes space / too big to handle easily; so かさばらない = 場所を取らない. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) かさ (嵩) is volume, not weight — a big box of light biscuits かさばる but is 重くない (4 is a different property). 2 and 3 are about handling and durability, not size.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第1回

items.q: 彼女は気まぐれな性格で、人に迷惑をかけることが多い。
items.qr: Kanojo wa kimagure na seikaku de, hito ni meiwaku o kakeru koto ga ooi.
items.en: She has a capricious nature and often causes trouble for others.

opts.en: acts on impulse / on a whim

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.73, PDF 155–156). Book's notes (paraphrased): 気まぐれな = acting on whatever occurs to you at the time; one's thinking and behaviour keep changing. 選択肢の言葉: 4 落ち着きがない = cannot stay still, gives a feeling of unease (例: あの子はいつも落ち着きがなくて、授業中もじっとすわっていられない (ano ko wa itsumo ochitsuki ga nakute, jugyouchuu mo jitto suwatte irarenai); the opposite — 彼、就職したら落ち着きが出て、大人っぽくなったね (kare, shuushoku shit
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第1回

items.q: 2人は双方の家族にお互いを紹介し合った間柄だ。
items.qr: Futari wa souhou no kazoku ni otagai o shoukai shiatta aidagara da.
items.en: The two are in a relationship where they have introduced each other to both families.

opts.en: a special bond, fate that ties people

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.74, PDF 156). Book's notes (paraphrased): 間柄 = the relationship between people. 選択肢の言葉: 4 縁 = a special, strong tie (例: あの2人は不思議な縁で知り合って、とうとう結婚することになったそうだ (ano futari wa fushigi na en de shiriatte, toutou kekkon suru koto ni natta sou da)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 2. (added, not in book) 間隔 shares the kanji 間 but means a gap in space or time (5分間隔); 関連 is for links between thing
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第1回

items.q: この論文にはタイトルがない。
items.qr: Kono ronbun ni wa taitoru ga nai.
items.en: This paper has no title.

opts.en: the main point / line of argument

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.74, PDF 156). Book's notes (paraphrased): タイトル = 題名 (or 肩書き). 選択肢の言葉: 1 主題 = テーマ (例: 家族の絆がこの作品の主題です (kazoku no kizuna ga kono sakuhin no shudai desu)); 3 論旨 = the important points of a paper or argument (例: あなたのこの論文は論旨が明快ではありませんね。ポイントを絞って書き直してください (anata no kono ronbun wa ronshi ga meikai de wa arimasen ne. Pointo o shibotte kakinaoshite kudasai)); 4 要旨 = the general content (例: 長い文
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第1回

items.q: 彼女は最近よく仕事をサボる。
items.qr: Kanojo wa saikin yoku shigoto o saboru.
items.en: She has been skipping work a lot lately.

opts.en: to skive, take time off dishonestly

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.74, PDF 156). Book's notes (paraphrased): サボる = ずる休みをする, staying away from work or school out of laziness. 選択肢の言葉: 1 (早く)さばく = to process (fast) (例: 彼女は有能な人だ。毎日山のような仕事を1人でさばいている (kanojo wa yuunou na hito da. Mainichi yama no you na shigoto o hitori de sabaite iru)). The 別冊 has no note for 3 or 4. (added, not in book) サボる (from French sabotage) sounds like さばく but means the opposite
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第2回

items.q: あの子は引っ込み思案で、なかなか友だちができない。
items.qr: Ano ko wa hikkomijian de, nakanaka tomodachi ga dekinai.
items.en: That child is shy and retiring, so finds it hard to make friends.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.74–75, PDF 156–157). Book's notes (paraphrased): 引っ込み思案 = 消極的, a personality that does not take the initiative. 選択肢の言葉: 4 勝気 = a very strong wish not to lose (例: 彼女は勝ち気で、ゲームに負けると、もう一度もう一度と、勝つまでやめない (kanojo wa kachiki de, geemu ni makeru to, mou ichido mou ichido to, katsu made yamenai)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 2. (added, not in book) 引っ込む = to withdraw; 思案 = thinking — "someone
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第2回

items.q: この絵は、色のコントラストが印象的だ。
items.qr: Kono e wa, iro no kontorasuto ga inshouteki da.
items.en: In this painting the contrast of colours is striking.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.75, PDF 157). Book's notes (paraphrased): コントラスト = 対比／対照, the difference between two contrasting things. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 1–3 are all things you might praise in a painting's colours, which is the trap: only 対比 carries the idea of two things set against each other, which is what "contrast" means.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第2回

items.q: うちの社長は目先の利益しか考えない人だ。
items.qr: Uchi no shachou wa mesaki no rieki shika kangaenai hito da.
items.en: Our president is a man who thinks only of immediate profit.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.75, PDF 157). Book's notes (paraphrased): 目先 here = 当座, the thing right in front of you / of the moment. 選択肢の言葉: 3 取引 = commercial dealings (例: 我が社はA社と取引をするのをやめた (waga sha wa A-sha to torihiki o suru no o yameta)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 2. (added, not in book) 1 将来 is the exact opposite of 目先 (the 別冊's ✎ example sets 目先 against 長い目で将来を見通す). 2 自分の利益 "his own profit" is a plausi
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第2回

items.q: 冷夏の影響で秋野菜が軒並み値上がりした。
items.qr: Reika no eikyou de aki yasai ga nokinami neagari shita.
items.en: Because of the cool summer, autumn vegetables have all gone up in price across the board.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.75, PDF 157). Book's notes (paraphrased): 軒並み here = 一様に, every single one. 選択肢の言葉: 4 大幅に／大幅な = (changing) greatly (例: 不景気で給料が大幅にカットされた (fukeiki de kyuuryou ga oohaba ni katto sareta)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 3. (added, not in book) 軒並み literally = "a row of eaves", i.e. every house in the street → every item. The distractors describe how much / how fast prices rose; 軒並み says w
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第2回

items.q: 若さを保つ秘訣はどんなことですか。
items.qr: Wakasa o tamotsu hiketsu wa donna koto desu ka.
items.en: What is your secret for staying young?
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.75, PDF 157). Book's notes (paraphrased): 秘訣 = an effective method that the person treasures and that others hardly know. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 訣 = "knack, secret method"; 秘 = "secret". So 秘訣 is a way of doing something (方法), never a value, a problem or a merit.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第2回

items.q: 彼は仕事の段取りがいい。
items.qr: Kare wa shigoto no dandori ga ii.
items.en: He is good at organising his work.

opts.en: the way he sets up the steps
the way he forecasts / sizes things up

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.75, PDF 157). Book's notes (paraphrased): 段取り = deciding the order or method (= 手順) of doing a job. 選択肢の言葉: 2 見通し = prospect, outlook (例: いつになったら好況が取り戻せるのだろうか。景気回復の見通しがつかない (itsu ni nattara koukyou ga torimodoseru no darou ka. Keiki kaifuku no mitooshi ga tsukanai)); 3 成果 = a good result (例: あの人は、会社で成果を出して出世することばかり考えているようだ (ano hito wa, kaisha de seika o dashite shusse suru koto bak
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第3回

items.q: 君にもらった地図は、古くて、てんで役に立たないよ。
items.qr: Kimi ni moratta chizu wa, furukute, tende yaku ni tatanai yo.
items.en: The map you gave me is old and no use at all.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.75–76, PDF 157–158). Book's notes (paraphrased): てんで〜ない = まるっきり〜ない, "not at all", common in casual speech. 選択肢の言葉: 1 ろくに〜ない = not sufficiently (例: サイズをろくに見ないでシャツを買ったら、子ども用だった (saizu o roku ni minaide shatsu o kattara, kodomo-you datta)); 2 かすかに = (feel) just a little (例: 水平線にかすかに島が見えるでしょう。あれが大島です (suiheisen ni kasuka ni shima ga mieru deshou. Are ga Ooshima desu)); 3 てっきり = (think)
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第3回

items.q: 彼女はこのごろいつも私にそっけない態度を見せる。
items.qr: Kanojo wa kono goro itsumo watashi ni sokkenai taido o miseru.
items.en: These days she always treats me coldly.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.76, PDF 158). Book's notes (paraphrased): そっけない = 冷淡な, having no interest or concern. 選択肢の言葉: 2 あやふやな = unclear whether true and unreliable (例: 記憶があやふやで、はっきり思い出せない (kioku ga ayafuya de, hakkiri omoidasenai)); 3 いいかげんな = not certain and irresponsible (例: また計算が違っている。こんないいかげんな報告書を書いたのはだれだ (mata keisan ga chigatte iru. Konna iikagen na houkokusho o kaita no wa dare da)). The 別冊 has no n
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第3回

items.q: 今年は車の修理の費用がかさんだ。
items.qr: Kotoshi wa kuruma no shuuri no hiyou ga kasanda.
items.en: This year the cost of car repairs has mounted up.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.76, PDF 158). Book's notes (paraphrased): かさむ = (of a quantity) to get bigger, to increase. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) かさむ shares its root with かさばる (第1回 Q3): 嵩 = bulk/volume. かさばる is physical bulk; かさむ is for costs and debts piling up (費用・出費・借金がかさむ). 1 and 2 are the opposite direction; 3 says nothing about amount.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第3回

items.q: 図書館で本を探すときは、まずジャンルで検索するのがよい。
items.qr: Toshokan de hon o sagasu toki wa, mazu janru de kensaku suru no ga yoi.
items.en: When looking for a book in the library, it is best to search by genre first.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.76, PDF 158). Book's notes (paraphrased): ジャンル = 種類, in particular the categories into which literary and other works are divided by style. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 2–4 are all real library search fields — the trap is that they are plausible, not that they are near in meaning. Only 種類 is a classification.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第3回

items.q: 彼女に対する私の思いは募るばかりだ。
items.qr: Kanojo ni taisuru watashi no omoi wa tsunoru bakari da.
items.en: My feelings for her only keep growing stronger.

opts.en: to lean to one side, be biased

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.76, PDF 158). Book's notes (paraphrased): 募る in this sentence = (a feeling) grows stronger. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 思いが募る・不安が募る・恋しさが募る are set phrases for intensifying emotion. 長引く is the near-miss — it is about duration (a long-lasting feeling), not intensity.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第3回

items.q: 彼女は周囲の人からちやほやされて育った。
items.u: ちやほやされて / chiyahoya sarete
items.qr: Kanojo wa shuui no hito kara chiyahoya sarete sodatta.
items.en: She grew up being pampered by everyone around her.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.76, PDF 158). Book's notes (paraphrased): ちやほやする = to please someone by flattering and indulging them — so the passive ちやほやされる = 甘やかされる. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 2 かわいがられて is the near-miss: it is plain affection with no negative shade, whereas ちやほや (like 甘やかす) implies the person was spoilt by it. 1 and 4 are opposites.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第4回

items.q: 週末はいつもこの通りがカップルで賑わう。
items.qr: Shuumatsu wa itsumo kono toori ga kappuru de nigiwau.
items.en: At weekends this street is always bustling with couples.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.76–77, PDF 158–159). Book's notes (paraphrased): カップル = a pair of one man and one woman, such as spouses or lovers. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 4 若者たち is the trap — couples on a weekend street are often young, but カップル says nothing about age, only about being a pair.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第4回

items.q: 大きな試合を前に、選手たちは練習に打ち込んでいる。
items.u: 打ち込んでいる / uchikonde iru
items.qr: Ookina shiai o mae ni, senshu-tachi wa renshuu ni uchikonde iru.
items.en: With a big match ahead, the players are throwing themselves into practice.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.77, PDF 159). Book's notes (paraphrased): 打ち込む = 熱中する／専心する. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 〜に打ち込む (仕事・研究・練習に) is about concentrated effort; 緊張・興奮 are emotional states, and 楽しむ says nothing about effort. Note 打ち込む also means literally "to drive in (a nail)" or "to type in" — context decides.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第4回

items.q: その船が消息を絶って1週間になる。
items.qr: Sono fune ga shousoku o tatte isshuukan ni naru.
items.en: It has been a week since all contact with that ship was lost.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.77, PDF 159). Book's notes (paraphrased): 消息を絶つ = contact stops arriving; the person's whereabouts become unknown. 選択肢の言葉: 2 通報 = informing the police or similar (例: 事故が起きたという通報を受けて、パトカーが現場に向かった (jiko ga okita to iu tsuuhou o ukete, patokaa ga genba ni mukatta)); 3 航海 = travelling over the sea by ship (例: タイタニック号の航海は悲劇的な結末に終わった (Taitanikku-gou no koukai wa higekiteki na ketsumatsu n
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第4回

items.q: 彼は時間にルーズな人だ。
items.qr: Kare wa jikan ni ruuzu na hito da.
items.en: He is slack about time.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.77, PDF 159). Book's notes (paraphrased): ルーズな = だらしない, not kept properly in order. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 時間に細かい・時間に厳しい are the opposite (punctilious about time). 鈍い is a false friend from English "loose → slow"; ルーズ is about discipline, not speed.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第4回

items.q: 私が出した案は会議ですんなりと決まった。
items.qr: Watashi ga dashita an wa kaigi de sunnari to kimatta.
items.en: The proposal I put forward was approved at the meeting without any fuss.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.77, PDF 159). Book's notes (paraphrased): すんなり here = 問題なく, 順調に. 選択肢の言葉: 3 かろうじて = やっと／ぎりぎりで, barely (例: レポートの締め切りに遅れそうだったが、かろうじて間に合った (repooto no shimekiri ni okuresou datta ga, karoujite ma ni atta)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 4. (added, not in book) 1, 3 and 4 all imply difficulty before success (ようやく = after a long wait; かろうじて = by a hair; なんとか = somehow). すんなり is the reverse
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第4回

items.q: 事件解決の手掛かりは全くない。
items.qr: Jiken kaiketsu no tegakari wa mattaku nai.
items.en: There is absolutely no clue to solving the case.

opts.en: a clue, the thread-end to pull

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.77, PDF 159). Book's notes (paraphrased): 手掛かり = 糸口, the beginning of a solution, the thing that becomes the key to it. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 糸口 is literally "the end of the thread" you pull to unravel a knot — a starting point, not the whole 方法／手段 (how you proceed) and not the 正解 (the finished answer).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第5回

items.q: 私にその仕事をこなすことができるだろうか。
items.qr: Watashi ni sono shigoto o konasu koto ga dekiru darou ka.
items.en: I wonder whether I can handle that job.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.78, PDF 160). Book's notes (paraphrased): こなす = 処理する, to get (work) done properly. 選択肢の言葉: 1 把握する = to understand firmly (例: 私にはこの文章の意味が把握できない (watashi ni wa kono bunshou no imi ga haaku dekinai)). The 別冊 has no note for 2 or 3. (added, not in book) 2 完了する is the near-miss — it only marks the end point, whereas こなす／処理する covers dealing competently with the whole task (仕事をこなす・注文をさばく・案
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第5回

items.q: 宿泊したホテルのサービスは申し分なかった。
items.u: 申し分なかった / moushibun nakatta
items.qr: Shukuhaku shita hoteru no saabisu wa moushibun nakatta.
items.en: The service at the hotel we stayed in was impeccable.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.78, PDF 160). Book's notes (paraphrased): 申し分ない = 完璧だ, nothing insufficient or unsatisfactory from any angle. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) The 〜ない ending makes 申し分ない look negative, so 2 and 3 (both mildly negative judgements) are the traps; it literally means "there is nothing one could say against it" — fully positive. 月並み is tested again in 第7回 Q4
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第5回

items.q: これだけの貯金があれば、当面は困らないだろう。
items.qr: Kore dake no chokin ga areba, toumen wa komaranai darou.
items.en: With this much saved, we won't be in trouble for the time being.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.78, PDF 160). Book's notes (paraphrased): 当面 = さしあたり, for now (the future being unknown). The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) All four are time words, but 近頃 looks back (recent past), 直ちに is a point (right now, at once), and 将来 is the far side — 当面 is the stretch from now into the near future.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第5回

items.q: この辺でちょっと一服しようか。
items.qr: Kono hen de chotto ippuku shiyou ka.
items.en: Shall we take a short break about now?
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.78, PDF 160). Book's notes (paraphrased): 一服する = 休憩する. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 1 休養 is the near-miss: it means days of rest to recover health (休養を取る), far too long for ちょっと一服. 一服 originally = one puff of tobacco or one cup of tea — hence a few minutes' pause.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第5回

items.q: これは日本酒をベースにした、さわやかで飲みやすいお酒です。
items.qr: Kore wa nihonshu o beesu ni shita, sawayaka de nomiyasui o-sake desu.
items.en: This is a refreshing, easy-to-drink liquor based on sake.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.78, PDF 160). Book's notes (paraphrased): ベース = 基礎, what something is built on / its main material. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 1 材料 is the trap: sake is an ingredient here, but 〜をベースにする means "take X as the foundation and build on it", which is 基礎, not just "one of the ingredients". Compare the 別冊's ✎ example, where ベース is a pay scale — no ingredi
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第5回

items.q: 当店は、「どの店よりも安く」をモットーにしている。
items.qr: Touten wa, "dono mise yori mo yasuku" o mottoo ni shite iru.
items.en: Our shop's motto is "cheaper than any other shop".
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.79, PDF 161). Book's notes (paraphrased): モットー = a word or phrase expressing one's aim. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) The quoted slogan is about price, which makes 2 and 4 tempting, but モットー is the slogan itself — a short phrase stating what you aim for — not a price level or a rule.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第6回

items.q: この仕事のこつを教えてください。
items.qr: Kono shigoto no kotsu o oshiete kudasai.
items.en: Please teach me the knack of this job.

opts.en: the knack, the essential point of how to do it

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.79, PDF 161). Book's notes (paraphrased): こつ = 要領, a way of doing things well. 選択肢の言葉: 3 手順 = the order in which things are done (例: 機械を動かす手順は、この説明書に書いてあるから、その通りにやってください (kikai o ugokasu tejun wa, kono setsumeisho ni kaite aru kara, sono toori ni yatte kudasai)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 2. (added, not in book) 手順 is the near-miss: a manual can tell you the 手順, but こつ／要領 is the e
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第6回

items.q: 夏の暑さをしのぐためのよい方法はないでしょうか。
items.qr: Natsu no atsusa o shinogu tame no yoi houhou wa nai deshou ka.
items.en: Is there a good way to get through the summer heat?
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.79, PDF 161). Book's notes (paraphrased): しのぐ (凌ぐ) here = to bear something painful and somehow pull through. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 1 冷やす fits "summer heat" on the surface, but しのぐ does not remove the heat — you survive it (暑さ・寒さ・飢えをしのぐ). しのぐ also has a second sense, "to surpass" (前作をしのぐ), not tested here.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第6回

items.q: いいか。途中で投げ出しちゃだめだぞ。
items.qr: Ii ka. Tochuu de nagedashicha dame da zo.
items.en: Listen — you mustn't give up halfway, OK?
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.79, PDF 161). Book's notes (paraphrased): 投げ出す = to give up and stop before everything is finished. 選択肢の言葉 (the 別冊 just expands each casual form): 1 あきちゃ = あきては; 2 やめちゃ = やめては; 3 失敗しちゃ = 失敗しては; 4 休んじゃ = 休んでは. (added, not in book) あきる (get bored) is often the reason people give up, but it is not the act of quitting; 投げ出す literally "throw out" = abandon, i.e. やめる.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第6回

items.q: 猫の体の動きは非常にしなやかだ。
items.qr: Neko no karada no ugoki wa hijou ni shinayaka da.
items.en: A cat's movements are extremely supple.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.79, PDF 161). Book's notes (paraphrased): しなやかな = soft and bending well. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) All four could describe a cat. しなやか is specifically about flexibility (bending without breaking), so only 柔らかい matches; 軽い (軽やか) and 速い are different qualities.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第6回

items.q: 妻を驚かせようと、ひそかに結婚記念日のプレゼントを用意した。
items.qr: Tsuma o odorokaseyou to, hisoka ni kekkon kinenbi no purezento o youi shita.
items.en: To surprise my wife, I secretly got a wedding-anniversary present ready.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.79, PDF 161). Book's notes (paraphrased): ひそかに = こっそり, so that others won't know. 選択肢の言葉: 1 くっきり = (a shape is seen) clearly (例: 今日は天気がよくて空気もきれいで、青い空を背景に雪で真っ白の富士山がくっきり見える (kyou wa tenki ga yokute kuuki mo kirei de, aoi sora o haikei ni yuki de masshiro no Fujisan ga kukkiri mieru)); 3 ばっさり = (cut) in one go (例: 彼女は長く伸ばしていた髪をばっさり切った (kanojo wa nagaku nobashite ita kami o bassari kitt
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第6回

items.q: 彼はその仕事を、いやな顔などみじんも見せずに引き受けた。
items.qr: Kare wa sono shigoto o, iya na kao nado mijin mo misezu ni hikiuketa.
items.en: He took on the job without showing the slightest sign of reluctance.

opts.en: (not) at all — no change however long

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.79, PDF 161). Book's notes (paraphrased): みじんも〜ない = ほんの少しも〜ない. 選択肢の言葉: 3 一向に〜ない = no change at all / nothing happens however long you wait (例: いくら体に悪いと言っても彼女は一向に禁煙しようとしない (ikura karada ni warui to itte mo kanojo wa ikkou ni kin'en shiyou to shinai)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 2. (added, not in book) あまり・ほとんど are partial negation ("not much / barely"); 一向に is total but tied to "no
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第7回

items.q: いい加減なことを言わないでください。
items.qr: Iikagen na koto o iwanaide kudasai.
items.en: Please don't say irresponsible things.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.79–80, PDF 161–162). Book's notes (paraphrased): いい加減な = 無責任な, careless and unreliable. 選択肢の言葉: 1 不公平な = not fair; 3 無礼な = 失礼な (例: 知り合いでもないのに、『おばあちゃん』と声をかけるなんて、無礼なやつだ (shiriai de mo nai no ni, "obaachan" to koe o kakeru nante, burei na yatsu da)). The 別冊 has no note for 4. (added, not in book) 無礼 and 不適当 judge politeness and suitability; いい加減 judges reliability — saying things witho
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第7回

items.q: 社会生活を営む上では、妥協することも必要だ。
items.qr: Shakai seikatsu o itonamu ue de wa, dakyou suru koto mo hitsuyou da.
items.en: In living in society, you also need to compromise.

opts.en: to come to terms, meet halfway

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.80, PDF 162). Book's notes (paraphrased): 妥協する = 折り合う, opposing parties give ground to each other to settle things. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) All options are 〜合う "mutual" verbs and all are social virtues; the key element of 妥協 is giving up part of your demand, which only 折り合う (折る = to bend) expresses.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第7回

items.q: 企画課の社員は明日のプレゼンテーションの準備で忙しい。
items.u: プレゼンテーション / purezenteeshon
items.qr: Kikakuka no shain wa ashita no purezenteeshon no junbi de isogashii.
items.en: The planning department staff are busy preparing for tomorrow's presentation.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.80, PDF 162). Book's notes (paraphrased): プレゼンテーション = 発表. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) A presentation often happens at a 会議 or leads to a 契約, but the word itself is the act of presenting — 発表.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第7回

items.q: 前途のある若者たちを教えるのは、やりがいのあることです。
items.qr: Zento no aru wakamono-tachi o oshieru no wa, yarigai no aru koto desu.
items.en: Teaching young people with a future ahead of them is rewarding work.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.80, PDF 162). Book's notes (paraphrased): 前途 = 将来. 選択肢の言葉: 2 やる気 = a strong will to do things actively (例: やる気さえあれば、難しい仕事もうまくいくはずだ (yaruki sae areba, muzukashii shigoto mo umaku iku hazu da)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 3. (added, not in book) 才能・やる気・能力 are all qualities a promising youth might "have" (〜のある若者), which is the trap; 前途 (前 = ahead, 途 = road) is the road ahead — 将来. 前途の
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第7回

items.q: あの評論家が言っていることは月並みだ。
items.qr: Ano hyouronka ga itte iru koto wa tsukinami da.
items.en: What that critic says is commonplace.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.80, PDF 162). Book's notes (paraphrased): 月並みだ = 平凡だ, ordinary with nothing excellent or different about it, and carrying the negative sense of "boring". The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 3 常識的だ is the near-miss: it is neutral-to-positive ("sensible"), while 月並み is a put-down. 1 and 4 are the opposite.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第7回

items.q: 景気が回復しそうな兆しが少しずつ現れている。
items.qr: Keiki ga kaifuku shisou na kizashi ga sukoshi zutsu arawarete iru.
items.en: Signs that the economy may recover are gradually appearing.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.80, PDF 162). Book's notes (paraphrased): 兆し = 前ぶれ, a sign that shows itself before something happens. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 予想 and 希望 are in people's heads; 兆し is something you can observe (現れる). 証明 is proof after the fact, not a forewarning.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第8回

items.q: 新しいソフトを使ってみたところ、パソコンの作業がはかどった。
items.qr: Atarashii sofuto o tsukatte mita tokoro, pasokon no sagyou ga hakadotta.
items.en: When I tried the new software, my computer work went much faster.

opts.en: took a lot of time / trouble

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.81, PDF 163). Book's notes (paraphrased): はかどる = (work or study) progresses smoothly and steadily. 選択肢の言葉: 1 手間取る = not going smoothly, taking time / はかどらない (例: 論文に取り掛かったのだが、資料集めに手間取っていて一向に進まない (ronbun ni torikakatta no da ga, shiryou atsume ni temadotte ite ikkou ni susumanai)). The 別冊 has no note for 3 or 4. (added, not in book) はかどる is about the pace of progress, not completion (
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第8回

items.q: お手元の資料にある表のデータをご覧ください。
items.qr: O-temoto no shiryou ni aru hyou no deeta o goran kudasai.
items.en: Please look at the data in the table in the handout in front of you.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.81, PDF 163). Book's notes (paraphrased): データ = 数値, numbers used as material. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 計算 is what you do with data; 予定・企画 are plans. A 表 (table) holds figures → 数値.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第8回

items.q: 彼は私の目をまともに見ようとしなかった。
items.qr: Kare wa watashi no me o matomo ni miyou to shinakatta.
items.en: He would not look me straight in the eye.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.81, PDF 163). Book's notes (paraphrased): まともに = straight from directly in front / in an ordinary way. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 真面目に (2) is the sound-and-meaning trap: まとも can mean "decent, proper" (まともな人), close to 真面目, but with 目を見る the sense is physical — straight on, so まっすぐに.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第8回

items.q: こんなありきたりな発想から生まれた商品は売れるはずがない。
items.u: ありきたりな / arikitari na
items.qr: Konna arikitari na hassou kara umareta shouhin wa ureru hazu ga nai.
items.en: A product born of such an unoriginal idea can't possibly sell.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.81, PDF 163). Book's notes (paraphrased): ありきたりな = ありふれた, ordinary with nothing different about it, with the negative sense "boring". 選択肢の言葉: 2 手軽な = simple, no trouble (例: このスーツケースは大きすぎないし軽いので、手軽に持ち運べて旅行に便利だ (kono suutsukeesu wa ookisuginai shi karui node, tegaru ni mochihakobete ryokou ni benri da)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 4. (added, not in book) 4 一般的な is neutral (widely app
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第8回

items.q: 彼の生き方は行き当たりばったりだ。
items.u: 行き当たりばったり / ikiatari battari
items.qr: Kare no ikikata wa ikiatari battari da.
items.en: He lives his life without any plan.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.81, PDF 163). Book's notes (paraphrased): 行き当たりばったり = 無計画, not preparing or thinking things out in advance. 選択肢の言葉: 3 無神経(な) = not caring what others dislike or find a nuisance / inconsiderate (例: 医者の無神経な言葉が患者の心を傷つけた (isha no mushinkei na kotoba ga kanja no kokoro o kizutsuketa)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 2. (added, not in book) 1 and 2 are opposites; 3 shares the 無〜 prefix but i
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第8回

items.q: 彼は寛大な人だから、きっと許してくれるだろう。
items.qr: Kare wa kandai na hito da kara, kitto yurushite kureru darou.
items.en: He is a broad-minded man, so he will surely forgive you.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.81, PDF 163). Book's notes (paraphrased): 寛大な = 心が広い, able to accept others' actions and ideas. 選択肢の言葉: 2 世話好きな = likes taking care of others (例: 私の母は世話好きで、近所にいる一人暮らしの老人に毎日昼食を届けている (watashi no haha wa sewazuki de, kinjo ni iru hitorigurashi no roujin ni mainichi chuushoku o todokete iru)); 3 温厚な = calm and gentle by nature (例: あの先生はとても温厚な方だ。彼が大きな声で怒っているのを見たことがない (ano sensei wa totem
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第9回

items.q: 新商品の発売に向けて、目下準備が進められている。
items.qr: Shin-shouhin no hatsubai ni mukete, mokka junbi ga susumerarete iru.
items.en: Preparations for the launch of the new product are currently under way.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.82, PDF 164). Book's notes (paraphrased): 目下 = ただ今, right now, currently. 選択肢の言葉: 4 すみやかに = quickly (例: 校舎が古くなって危険なので、すみやかに対策を立ててほしいと、保護者たちは学校に要望書を出した (kousha ga furuku natte kiken na node, sumiyaka ni taisaku o tatete hoshii to, hogosha-tachi wa gakkou ni youbousho o dashita)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 2. (added, not in book) 1, 2 and 4 describe how fast; 目下 says when — now. Car
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第9回

items.q: ここに高層ビルを建設する計画は見送られることになった。
items.qr: Koko ni kousou biru o kensetsu suru keikaku wa miokurareru koto ni natta.
items.en: The plan to build a high-rise here has been shelved.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.82, PDF 164). Book's notes (paraphrased): 見送る = not to do it, leaving things as they are. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 2 is the opposite; 3 and 4 mean the plan goes ahead in altered form. 見送る suggests "not now, maybe later" (shelving rather than cancelling — 中止).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第9回

items.q: 髪が伸びて、うっとうしくなってきた。
items.qr: Kami ga nobite, uttoushiku natte kita.
items.en: My hair has grown and is getting annoying.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.82–83, PDF 164–165). Book's notes (paraphrased): うっとうしい = in the way, giving an unpleasant feeling. 選択肢の言葉: 3 ゆううつ(な) = a heavy, unpleasant mood (例: ああ、せっかくの日曜日なのに社長の命令で接待ゴルフをしなければならないなんてゆううつだな (aa, sekkaku no nichiyoubi na no ni shachou no meirei de settai gorufu o shinakereba naranai nante yuuutsu da na)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 2. (added, not in book) うっとうしい has two senses:

items.q: 最近あの課の上司と部下の間には摩擦が生じているようだ。
items.qr: Saikin ano ka no joushi to buka no aida ni wa masatsu ga shoujite iru you da.
items.en: There seems to be friction lately between the boss and his staff in that section.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.83, PDF 165). Book's notes (paraphrased): 摩擦 here = 不和, being on bad terms. 選択肢の言葉: 2 好意 = the feeling of liking someone (例: 彼は彼女に好意を持っているみたいだけど、彼女のほうはどうだろうか (kare wa kanojo ni koui o motte iru mitai da kedo, kanojo no hou wa dou darou ka)); 3 合意 = views coinciding (例: 交渉の結果、2つの会社は合意し、近々契約を結ぶことになった (koushou no kekka, futatsu no kaisha wa goui shi, chikajika keiyaku o musubu koto ni
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第9回

items.q: 今度の仕事は、まったく新しいアプローチで行われる。
items.qr: Kondo no shigoto wa, mattaku atarashii apuroochi de okonawareru.
items.en: The next job will be carried out with an entirely new approach.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.83, PDF 165). Book's notes (paraphrased): アプローチ here = the way of approaching one's goal, i.e. 方法. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 1 目的 appears in the 別冊's own definition — a trap: アプローチ is the way toward the goal, not the goal. 〜で行われる also calls for a means (方法で).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第9回

items.q: 工事がいつ終わるか目処が立たない。
items.u: 目処が立たない / medo ga tatanai
items.qr: Kouji ga itsu owaru ka medo ga tatanai.
items.en: There is no telling when the construction work will be finished.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.83, PDF 165). Book's notes (paraphrased): 目処が立たない = 見通しがつかない, impossible to predict. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 2 決まっていない is close but is about a decision; 目処 is about being able to foresee — even with no decision pending, nobody can estimate the end. 目処が立つ／つく = an end is in sight.
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第10回

items.q: 我々のチームのスタッフを紹介しましょう。
items.qr: Wareware no chiimu no sutaffu o shoukai shimashou.
items.en: Let me introduce the members of our team.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.83, PDF 165). Book's notes (paraphrased): スタッフ = メンバー, the people one works with. 選択肢の言葉 (glosses only): 2 リーダー = leader; 3 チーフ = chief/leader; 4 モニター = monitor. (added, not in book) 2 and 3 are single people at the top; スタッフ is everyone on the team. モニター in Japanese also means a consumer tester (商品モニター).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第10回

items.q: 私は彼女にさんざん迷惑をかけている。
items.qr: Watashi wa kanojo ni sanzan meiwaku o kakete iru.
items.en: I have caused her no end of trouble.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.83–84, PDF 165–166). Book's notes (paraphrased): さんざん = 大変, badly enough to be sickening. 選択肢の言葉: 1 時折 = ときどき (例: 明日は、午前は天気がよくても午後は時折小雨が降りますから、傘を持ってお出かけください (ashita wa, gozen wa tenki ga yokute mo gogo wa tokiori kosame ga furimasu kara, kasa o motte o-dekake kudasai)); 2 通常 = 普通は／いつもは (例: 重役会議は通常水曜日に開かれるが、今週は火曜日に変更された (juuyaku kaigi wa tsuujou suiyoubi ni hirakareru ga, konshuu wa
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第10回

items.q: その手紙からは、彼女の人となりがよく伝わってきます。
items.qr: Sono tegami kara wa, kanojo no hitonari ga yoku tsutawatte kimasu.
items.en: That letter conveys her character very well.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.84, PDF 166). Book's notes (paraphrased): 人となり = 人柄, the personality that characterises someone. The 別冊 gives no 選択肢の言葉 for this question. (added, not in book) 人となり looks like 人 + なる, tempting 人生 or 生き方; it is fixed as "a person's nature", which is 人柄 (also a 人〜 word).
items.unit: 言い換え類義 第10回

items.q: この部屋の家具はどれも洗練されている。
items.u: 洗練されている / senren sarete iru
items.qr: Kono heya no kagu wa dore mo senren sarete iru.
items.en: Every piece of furniture in this room is refined.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.84, PDF 166). Book's notes (paraphrased): 洗練されている = 上品だ. 選択肢の言葉: 2 質素(な) = having only what is necessary, not spending on extras, not living lavishly (例: A氏は今や大企業の社長だが、貧しかった昔と変わらない質素な生活をしているという (A-shi wa ima ya daikigyou no shachou da ga, mazushikatta mukashi to kawaranai shisso na seikatsu o shite iru to iu)); 4 精巧(な) = made accurately down to the finest detail (例: この人形は精巧に作られているので

items.q: あの人がしくじるなんて、考えられない。
items.qr: Ano hito ga shikujiru nante, kangaerarenai.
items.en: I can't imagine that person messing up.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.84, PDF 166). Book's notes (paraphrased): しくじる = 失敗する. 選択肢の言葉: 2 ごまかす = to do something dishonest so others won't notice (例: 子どものとき、母に頼まれて買い物に行った。そのとき、おつりをごまかして、母にひどく怒られた (kodomo no toki, haha ni tanomarete kaimono ni itta. Sono toki, otsuri o gomakashite, haha ni hidoku okorareta)). The 別冊 has no note for 1 or 4. (added, not in book) 1, 2 and 4 are all moral failings (betraying, ch

items.q: 店の売上金額は、毎日出納帳に記入しています。
items.qr: Mise no uriage kingaku wa, mainichi suitouchou ni kinyuu shite imasu.
items.en: Every day we write the shop's sales figures in the cash book.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.2, PDF 86). Book's notes (paraphrased): 出納帳 = すいとうちょう, an account book. In the 漢字 block, 出 has the reading スイ and 納 the reading トウ only in the word 出納 (money in and out); otherwise 出 is シュツ (出演, 出世) and 納 is ノウ (納税). (added, not in book) Option 4 is the trap: it uses each kanji's everyday reading, which is exactly what reading type 5 on p.3 warns about. 1 and 2 mix kun/on pieces tha

items.q: 失業して、家賃や税金の支払いが滞ってしまった。
items.qr: Shitsugyou shite, yachin ya zeikin no shiharai ga todokootte shimatta.
items.en: After I lost my job, I fell behind on paying my rent and taxes.

opts.en: fall behind, be held up (滞る)
go back (to the past / upstream) (遡る)
lean to one side, be biased (偏る)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.2, PDF 86). Book's notes (paraphrased): 滞る = とどこおる; on-yomi タイ as in 滞納 (unpaid), 渋滞 (traffic jam). Its 選択肢の言葉 gives the kanji of the other options: 2 遡る, 3 偏る, 4 漂う — all real verbs, but none is written 滞. (added, not in book) All four end in 〜って, so only knowing the kanji helps; 支払いが滞る is the set phrase for late payment (compare 滞納).

items.q: パンをスープに浸して食べた。
items.qr: Pan o suupu ni hitashite tabeta.
items.en: I dipped the bread in the soup and ate it.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.2, PDF 86). Book's notes (paraphrased): 浸す = ひたす (dip); 浸る = ひたる (be soaked / be immersed, e.g. in joy); on-yomi シン as in 浸水. 選択肢の言葉 (別冊 p.3, PDF 87): 1 吊るす, 2 溶かす, 4 果たす. (added, not in book) 溶かす is the most tempting because soup is involved, but it means "dissolve", and its kanji is 溶, not 浸.

items.q: 出発の時刻になり、見送りに来た友人に別れを告げた。
items.qr: Shuppatsu no jikoku ni nari, miokuri ni kita yuujin ni wakare o tsugeta.
items.en: When it was time to leave, I said goodbye to the friends who had come to see me off.

opts.en: not the reading of 告げた

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.3, PDF 87). Book's notes (paraphrased): 告げる = つげる (tell, say); on-yomi コク as in 告知, 申告, 予告. 選択肢の言葉: 3 遂げる, 4 焦げる. (added, not in book) The four options differ only in the first kana (す/つ/と/こ + げた). 別れを告げる "bid farewell" is a fixed phrase worth learning whole. 1 is not given a kanji by the 別冊 — treat it as a non-answer.

items.q: 新聞の記事からニュースを抜粋して、レポートの参考にしている。
items.qr: Shinbun no kiji kara nyuusu o bassui shite, repooto no sankou ni shite iru.
items.en: I take extracts of news from newspaper articles and use them as reference for my report.

opts.en: wrong — the small っ is missing
wrong — kun-yomi ぬき mixed with on-yomi

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.3, PDF 87). Book's notes (paraphrased): 抜粋 = ばっすい; 抜 on-yomi バツ (抜群, 選抜, and ばっ in 抜歯 ばっし), kun-yomi ぬける / ぬく / ぬかす; 粋 = スイ (純粋, 無粋, and 粋 on its own = "the best part"). (added, not in book) This is trap type 3 from p.3: バツ + s-sound → ばっ. 1 ignores the 促音; 2 and 4 use the kun-yomi of 抜, which never appears in this two-kanji on-yomi compound.

items.q: あ、それでは上下が逆様ですよ。
items.qr: A, sore de wa jouge ga sakasama desu yo.
items.en: Oh, that way it's upside down.

opts.en: not a word here (ぎゃく without ゛)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.3, PDF 87). Book's notes (paraphrased): 逆様 = さかさま (upside down). 逆 has on-yomi ギャク (逆転, 逆流) and kun-yomi さか (逆さ, 逆立ち) / さからう; 様 has ヨウ (様式, 多様) and さま (お客様, 様変わり). (added, not in book) 逆様 uses both kun-yomi: さか + さま. Option 2 ぎゃくさま is the most tempting because each half is a real reading — but they come from different reading systems. 逆さ (さかさ) means the same thing.

items.q: 教会での結婚式の後、ホテルで披露宴が行われた。
items.qr: Kyoukai de no kekkonshiki no ato, hoteru de hirouen ga okonawareta.
items.en: After the wedding ceremony at the church, a reception was held at a hotel.

opts.en: wrong — extra long vowel in ひ
wrong — 露 needs the long ろう here

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.4, PDF 88). Book's notes (paraphrased): 披露宴 = ひろうえん. 披 = ヒ (披露); 露 has three readings — ロ (露骨, 露出, 暴露 ばくろ), ロウ (only in 披露) and つゆ (dew); 宴 = エン (宴会, 祝宴). (added, not in book) A pure trap-type-1 question (long vs short vowel): 披 is short ひ, 露 is long ろう. Options 3 and 4 use the ロ reading of 露 from 露骨 / 暴露, which is wrong inside 披露.

items.q: 顔色が冴えないね。どうしたの。
items.qr: Kaoiro ga saenai ne. Dou shita no.
items.en: You don't look well. What's wrong?

opts.en: never ends (絶える) / can't bear (堪える・耐える)

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.4, PDF 88). Book's notes (paraphrased): 冴える = さえる (be bright, clear, healthy-looking); 冴えない = dull, gloomy, not well; 例 冴えた月の光 (clear moonlight). 選択肢の言葉: 1 冷えない (冷える), 2 消えない (消える), 4 絶えない (絶える) / 堪えない (堪える) / 耐えない (耐える). (added, not in book) 冴 has 冫 (ice) like 冷 — that makes ひえない tempting — but 冷 is a different kanji. 顔色が冴えない is a set phrase for "look pale / off-colour".

items.q: 中途半端な気持ちでは、どんな仕事も務まらない。
items.qr: Chuutohanpa na kimochi de wa, donna shigoto mo tsutomaranai.
items.en: With a half-hearted attitude you can't do any job properly.

opts.en: wrong — kun-yomi はし used for 端
wrong — なか for 中 and a voiced ど
wrong — kun-yomi なか for 中

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.4, PDF 88). Book's notes (paraphrased): 中途半端 = ちゅうとはんぱ. 中 = チュウ (中継, 中断), ジュウ (一日中, 年中), なか (中程); 途 = ト (途上, 前途); 半 = ハン (半減), パン (折半), なか(ば); 端 = タン (端末, 極端), はし／はじ, は／ぱ (半端), はた (edge). (added, not in book) Two traps: 中 here is on-yomi ちゅう (it is a four-kanji on-yomi compound), and 端 after ん becomes ぱ (trap type 4, like 突風 とっぷう). はし is the kun-yomi "edge" and never appears in 半端.

items.q: そんなくだらない議論に貴重な時間を費やすのはやめよう。
items.qr: Sonna kudaranai giron ni kichou na jikan o tsuiyasu no wa yameyou.
items.en: Let's stop spending precious time on such a pointless argument.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.5, PDF 89). Book's notes (paraphrased): 費やす = ついやす; on-yomi ヒ／ピ as in 出費 (しゅっぴ), 交通費, 学費. 選択肢の言葉: 2 冷やす, 3 耕す, 4 燃やす. (added, not in book) ひやす is the trap because 費's on-yomi is ヒ — but the verb 費やす uses the kun-yomi つい. All four options end in 〜やす / 〜す, so the kanji itself must be known.

items.q: 彼は辛い仕事を忍耐強く続けている。
items.qr: Kare wa tsurai shigoto o nintai-zuyoku tsuzukete iru.
items.en: He keeps doing his hard job with great patience.

opts.en: wrong — たい should not be voiced

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.5, PDF 89). Book's notes (paraphrased): 忍耐 = にんたい. 忍 = ニン (忍術, 残忍) and しの(ぶ) (endure, hide); 耐 = タイ (耐久, 耐水, 耐火) and た(える) (endure). 選択肢の言葉: 1 人体. (added, not in book) Trap type 2 (清音 / 濁音): after ん a sound often becomes voiced (e.g. 三階 さんがい), but 耐 stays たい in 忍耐 — compare 耐久 たいきゅう. じんたい sounds similar but is a completely different word.

items.q: 彼女が仕事をするときの手際のよさには驚かされる。
items.qr: Kanojo ga shigoto o suru toki no tegiwa no yosa ni wa odorokasareru.
items.en: I'm amazed at how deftly she handles her work.

opts.en: hosting, sponsoring (主催) / presiding, running a group (主宰)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.5–6, PDF 89–90). Book's notes (paraphrased): 手際 = てぎわ (manner of doing, skill). 手 = シュ (手芸, 名手) and て (手順, 手配, 手本 …); 際 = サイ (際限 = limit) and きわ／ぎわ (窓際 = by the window). 選択肢の言葉: 3 主催 / 主宰. (added, not in book) 手際 is kun + kun, and 際 is voiced to ぎわ as the second element, exactly like 窓際 まどぎわ. Options 1 and 2 mix reading systems.

items.q: たとえ貧乏でも、愛があれば幸せだ。
items.qr: Tatoe binbou demo, ai ga areba shiawase da.
items.en: Even if you are poor, you can be happy if there is love.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.6, PDF 90). Book's notes (paraphrased): 貧乏 = びんぼう. 貧 has ヒン (貧血, 貧困, 貧弱), ビン (only 貧乏) and まず(しい); 乏 has ボウ (窮乏, 欠乏) and とぼ(しい). (added, not in book) Three traps at once: voiced び (not ひ), voiced ぼ (not ほ / ぽ), and a long vowel ぼう. びんぼ is how people sometimes say it casually, but the dictionary reading is びんぼう.

items.q: 今、夏休みの北海道旅行の計画を練っている。
items.qr: Ima, natsuyasumi no Hokkaidou ryokou no keikaku o nette iru.
items.en: I'm now working out the plan for my summer-holiday trip to Hokkaido.

opts.en: holding out, persisting; being sticky (粘る)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.6, PDF 90). Book's notes (paraphrased): 練る = ねる (polish, refine, work out a plan); on-yomi レン (試練, 洗練, 熟練). 選択肢の言葉: 1 沿っている (沿う), 2 粘っている (粘る), 3 担っている (担う). (added, not in book) ねばっている shares ね- with the answer and is about "sticking at it", so it looks plausible — but its kanji is 粘. 計画を練る / 対策を練る / 作戦を練る are the standard collocations.

items.q: 果てしない宇宙をいつか旅してみたい。
items.qr: Hateshinai uchuu o itsuka tabi shite mitai.
items.en: Some day I'd like to travel through boundless space.

opts.en: not the reading of 果てしない
not the reading of 果てしない

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.6–7, PDF 90–91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 果てしない = はてしない = 終わりがない (having no end). 果 = カ (果実, 効果, 成果) and は(てる) / は(たす) / 果て (the end). (added, not in book) The 別冊 gives no kanji for the wrong options; かてしない is the trap because カ is 果's on-yomi, but in this word 果 is kun-yomi は (果て = end + しない).

items.q: 対立する意見を折衷して結論を出した。
items.qr: Tairitsu suru iken o secchuu shite ketsuron o dashita.
items.en: We reached a conclusion by blending the opposing opinions into a compromise.

opts.en: wrong — the small っ is missing

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 折衷 = せっちゅう (mixing, compromise). 折 = セツ (折角 せっかく, 骨折, 右折, 挫折), お(れる)／お(る), おり (occasion); 衷 = チュウ (衷心). 選択肢の言葉: 1 折り合い. (added, not in book) Trap type 3: セツ + ch-sound → せっ (as in 折角 せっかく). 折り合い has a similar meaning ("compromise") — which makes it tempting — but it is written with okurigana and is not the reading of 折衷.

items.q: 職場で仕事中に人の噂話（うわさばなし）をするのは慎むべきだ。
items.qr: Shokuba de shigotochuu ni hito no uwasabanashi o suru no wa tsutsushimu beki da.
items.en: You should refrain from gossiping about people while working at the office.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 慎む = つつしむ (keep from doing, be careful not to); on-yomi シン as in 慎重 (careful) and 謹慎. 選択肢の言葉: 3 慈しむ, 4 はにかむ. (added, not in book) しんむ is the trap: シン is the on-yomi, but on-yomi never takes the verb ending む. 言動を慎む, 酒を慎む are common collocations.

items.q: 私は山の麓の静かな町で少年時代を過ごした。
items.qr: Watashi wa yama no fumoto no shizuka na machi de shounen jidai o sugoshita.
items.en: I spent my boyhood in a quiet town at the foot of a mountain.

opts.en: on-yomi of 麓 (only in compounds like 山麓)
gentle lower slopes of a mountain (裾野)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 麓 = ふもと; on-yomi ロク as in 山麓 (さんろく). 選択肢の言葉: 3 裾野, 4 鹿. (added, not in book) 麓 is built from 林 over 鹿 — that is why しか (鹿) is offered as a trap. すその is close in meaning, but it is written 裾野. On its own, 麓 is read with the kun-yomi ふもと.

items.q: 国際交流のイベントを催す計画が進んでいる。
items.qr: Kokusai kouryuu no ibento o moyoosu keikaku ga susunde iru.
items.en: Plans to hold an international exchange event are under way.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 催す = もよおす (hold an event); on-yomi サイ as in 催促, 開催, 主催; 催し物 = an event. 選択肢の言葉: 1 施す, 4 促す. (added, not in book) うながす is the trap: 催促 (さいそく) means "pressing someone", and 促 = うながす — but 促 and 催 are different kanji. 催す also means "feel (an urge)": 眠気を催す.

items.q: この庭には花の香りが漂っている。
items.qr: Kono niwa ni wa hana no kaori ga tadayotte iru.
items.en: The scent of flowers hangs in the air in this garden.

opts.en: be held up, fall behind (滞る)
drift, hang in the air (漂う)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.7, PDF 91). Book's notes (paraphrased): 漂う = ただよう (float, drift, hang in the air); on-yomi ヒョウ as in 漂流. 選択肢の言葉: 1 逆らって (逆らう), 2 操って (操る), 3 滞って (滞る). (added, not in book) 漂う and 滞る both have 氵 and were already paired in 第1回 Q2 — the book deliberately reuses them as each other's distractors.

items.q: この国の国民の大部分が貧困と闘っている。
items.qr: Kono kuni no kokumin no daibubun ga hinkon to tatakatte iru.
items.en: Most of this country's people are fighting poverty.

opts.en: not a word (困 is not いん)
wrong — び is only for 貧乏

items.why: Answer 4 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). The answer is supported by the book itself: the 別冊 p.6 (PDF 90) kanji block for 貧 (in Q13) lists 貧困（ひんこん）. (added, not in book) 貧 = ヒン in compounds (貧困, 貧血) and ビン only in 貧乏, so 1 and 3 are traps carried over from Q13. 困 = コン (困難); いん would be the reading of 因 (原因), which looks

items.q: これは彼の作品の中で最高の傑作だ。
items.qr: Kore wa kare no sakuhin no naka de saikou no kessaku da.
items.en: This is the greatest masterpiece among his works.

opts.en: wrong — 作 must be さく here
wrong — けつ shortened without っ
wrong — the small っ is missing

items.why: Answer 3 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). The answer is supported by the book itself: the 別冊 p.10 (PDF 92) kanji block for 作 (in Q27) lists 傑作（けっさく）. (added, not in book) 傑 = ケツ, 作 = サク. Trap type 3: ケツ + s-sound → けっ, so 傑作 = けっさく (like 傑出 けっしゅつ). 作 is サ only in some words (作業 さぎょう, 動作 どうさ), so けっさ (1) is wrong; 2 and 4

items.q: 彼女は細やかな心づかいのできる人だ。
items.qr: Kanojo wa komayaka na kokorozukai no dekiru hito da.
items.en: She is someone who can show thoughtful, attentive consideration for others.

opts.en: slender (rare word) — not the reading here
not a word (on-yomi サイ + やか)

items.why: Answer 1 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). (added, not in book) 細 has two kun-yomi: こま(か／かい) "fine, detailed" and ほそ(い) "thin". 細やか is read こまやか and is used for feelings and care (細やかな心づかい / 愛情). ほそやか exists only as a rare word for "slender", and does not fit 心づかい. ひそやか is written 密やか; さいやか is not a word.

items.q: 製品の良し悪しは見た目ではよくわからない。
items.qr: Seihin no yoshiashi wa mitame de wa yoku wakaranai.
items.en: You can't really tell whether a product is good or bad from how it looks.
items.why: Answer 4 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). (added, not in book) 良し悪し uses the old classical adjective forms 良し (よし, "good") and 悪し (あし, "bad"), both kun-yomi. The trap is わる from 悪い: in this fixed word 悪 is あし, not わるし. Options 2 and 3 use the on-yomi りょう of 良, which never takes the ending し. (よしあし can also mean "having b

items.q: 社会生活において重要なことは、円滑な人間関係を築くことだ。
items.qr: Shakai seikatsu ni oite juuyou na koto wa, enkatsu na ningen kankei o kizuku koto da.
items.en: What matters in social life is building smooth, harmonious relationships with people.

opts.en: wrong — 滑 read as コツ

items.why: Answer 3 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). (added, not in book) 円滑 is an on + on compound: 円 = エン, 滑 = カツ. The trap is コツ: 滑 has the rare on-yomi コツ only in 滑稽 (こっけい), and the right-hand part 骨 (コツ) suggests it. Options 1 and 2 use the kun-yomi まる(い) and すべ(る), which do not appear in this compound.

items.q: 田中選手が今季限りで競技を退くそうだ。
items.qr: Tanaka senshu ga konki kagiri de kyougi o shirizoku sou da.
items.en: I hear Tanaka is retiring from the sport at the end of this season.
items.why: Answer 1 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (別冊 pp.8–9 are not in the PDF; not from the official key). (added, not in book) 退く = しりぞく (withdraw, retire from a post or field); on-yomi タイ as in 引退 (retirement) — 競技を退く means the same as 引退する. 退く can also be read のく ("step aside"), but that is not an option. たいく wrongly puts a verb ending on the on-yomi; 導く and 嘆く are real verbs with

items.q: 「そんなことはわけないさ」と彼は無造作に言った。
items.qr: "Sonna koto wa wake nai sa" to kare wa muzousa ni itta.
items.en: "That's nothing — easy," he said casually.

opts.en: wrong — 作 must be さ
wrong — 無 must be む

items.why: Answer 4 — reasoned, official key page missing from the scan (the 正解 line for Q27 was on 別冊 p.9, which is not in the PDF; not from the official key). Supported by the surviving 漢字 blocks (別冊 p.10, PDF 92): 無 has ム (無能, 無用, 無論) and ブ (無愛想, 無難, 無礼); 造 = ゾウ (偽造, 構造, 木造); 作 = サク (作戦, 傑作) and サ (作用, 発作). The book listing サ for 作 confirms むぞうさ. (added, not in book) Two traps: 無 = む here, not ぶ (ぶ is onl

items.q: 2つの町を隔てていた川に橋がかけられた。
items.qr: Futatsu no machi o hedatete ita kawa ni hashi ga kakerareta.
items.en: A bridge has been built across the river that separated the two towns.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.10, PDF 92). Book's notes (paraphrased): 隔てる = へだてる (divide, separate); 隔たる = be distant; 隔たり = gap. On-yomi カク as in 隔週, 隔離, 間隔. 選択肢の言葉: 3 そばだてて (そばだてる), 4 おだてて (おだてる). (added, not in book) All four options end in 〜だてて / 〜ばてて; only the kanji tells you. 耳をそばだてる (listen hard) and 人をおだてる (flatter) are usually written in kana.

items.q: 言論の自由が束縛される国もある。
items.qr: Genron no jiyuu ga sokubaku sareru kuni mo aru.
items.en: There are countries where freedom of speech is restricted.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.10, PDF 92). Book's notes (paraphrased): 束縛 = そくばく. 束 = ソク (拘束, 結束), たば (bundle; 花束), たば(ねる), つか (束の間); 縛 = バク (呪縛) and しば(る) (tie, bind). (added, not in book) 1 and 3 use the kun-yomi たば; じゅう / せん come from kanji that look like 縛 (縦 じゅう, 繊 せん — both 糸-radical). 4 adds a 促音 that the word doesn't have.

items.q: 彼はいつも見栄を張って部下に食事をおごっている。
items.qr: Kare wa itsumo mie o hatte buka ni shokuji o ogotte iru.
items.en: To show off, he is always treating his subordinates to meals.

opts.en: wrong — kun み + on エイ

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.11, PDF 93). Book's notes (paraphrased): 見栄 = みえ (show, vanity, display). 見 = ケン (見識, 会見, 外見) and み(る／える／せる); 栄 = エイ (光栄, 虚栄, 繁栄) and さか(える). (added, not in book) This is trap type 6 (irregular reading): 栄 is just え here — the word comes from 見え ("how one looks") and the kanji was attached later. 虚栄 (きょえい, vanity) has a similar meaning but the normal reading.

items.q: テレビで紹介されて以来、店が繁盛するようになった。
items.qr: Terebi de shoukai sarete irai, mise ga hanjou suru you ni natta.
items.en: Ever since it was featured on TV, the shop has been doing very good business.

opts.en: reflection (反省) / half a lifetime (半生)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.11, PDF 93). Book's notes (paraphrased): 繁盛 = はんじょう (prosperity, a thriving business). 繁 = ハン (繁栄, 繁華街, 頻繁) and しげ(る); 盛 = セイ (盛大, 全盛), ジョウ (繁盛), も(る), さか(る／り／ん). 選択肢の言葉: 2 反省 / 半生. (added, not in book) はんせい is the trap: セイ is 盛's usual on-yomi, but in 繁盛 it is ジョウ (trap type 5 — a kanji with many readings). Compare 繁栄 はんえい, which means the same thing.

items.q: 被災地では復興（ふっこう）に協力するボランティアを募っている。
items.qr: Hisaichi de wa fukkou ni kyouryoku suru borantia o tsunotte iru.
items.en: In the disaster area they are calling for volunteers to help with the reconstruction.
items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.11, PDF 93). Book's notes (paraphrased): 募る = つのる (call for, advertise for, recruit); on-yomi ボ as in 募金, 応募. 選択肢の言葉: 2 慕って (慕う), 4 下って (下る). (added, not in book) 募 and 慕 share the top part 莫 — that's why したって is offered. Remember the bottom: 力 in 募 ("gather with effort") vs ⺗ (a form of 心) in 慕 ("feel for"). 募る also means "grow stronger" for feelings: 不安が募る.

items.q: この作品は情景の細かい描写が評価されている。
items.qr: Kono sakuhin wa joukei no komakai byousha ga hyouka sarete iru.
items.en: This work is praised for its detailed description of scenes.

opts.en: wrong — big よ instead of small ょ

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.12, PDF 94). Book's notes (paraphrased): 描写 = びょうしゃ. 描 = ビョウ (素描) and えが(く) (draw, depict); 写 = シャ (写生, 映写, 試写会) and うつ(る／す). (added, not in book) 描 looks like 猫 (ねこ, ビョウ) — same sound. ひょう (1) drops the ゛ (trap type 2); びよう (2) tests whether you notice the small ょ (びょう = 1 syllable + long vowel, びよう = 3 syllables, like 美容).

items.q: 他人の成功を妬むのはやめよう。
items.qr: Tanin no seikou o netamu no wa yameyou.
items.en: Let's stop being jealous of other people's success.

opts.en: feel resentful, have a chip on one's shoulder (僻む)
get tangled; pick a quarrel (絡む)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.12, PDF 94). Book's notes (paraphrased): 妬む = ねたむ (be jealous, envious); on-yomi ト as in 嫉妬 (しっと). 選択肢の言葉: 1 睨む, 2 僻む, 3 絡む. (added, not in book) ひがむ is close in feeling — but 僻む is feeling hard done by ("only I get treated badly"), while 妬む is resenting someone else's good fortune. Both 妬む and 僻む are often written in kana.

items.q: 待遇の改善を求めて、従業員がストライキを行った。
items.qr: Taiguu no kaizen o motomete, juugyouin ga sutoraiki o okonatta.
items.en: The employees went on strike demanding better working conditions.

opts.en: wrong — 待 read like 寺 (ジ)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.12, PDF 94). Book's notes (paraphrased): 待遇 = たいぐう (treatment, working conditions). 待 = タイ (待望, 待機, 接待) and ま(つ) (待ち遠しい, 待ち合わせ); 遇 = グウ (遭遇, 優遇, 奇遇). (added, not in book) The 別冊 lists no wrong-option words here. 待 contains 寺 (ジ) and 遇 contains 禺 — options 2 and 4 play on these parts. 待遇 also means how you treat a guest: 手厚い待遇.

items.q: インターネットで電話料金の内訳を確認した。
items.qr: Intaanetto de denwa ryoukin no uchiwake o kakunin shita.
items.en: I checked the breakdown of my phone bill on the internet.

opts.en: informal agreement (内約) — not the reading here

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.12–13, PDF 94–95). Book's notes (paraphrased): 内訳 = うちわけ (breakdown of expenses). 内 = ナイ (内閣, 内緒, 内臓) and うち (内側); 訳 = ヤク (翻訳, 英訳) and わけ (reason). (added, not in book) A kun + kun word: うち + わけ ("dividing up the inside"). ないやく is the on + on reading, which looks natural but is not this word. Other kun + kun money words: 割引 わりびき, 手当 てあて.

items.q: 健康のために、酒はなるべく控えたほうがいい。
items.qr: Kenkou no tame ni, sake wa narubeku hikaeta hou ga ii.
items.en: For your health, you'd better cut down on alcohol as much as possible.

opts.en: put in order, line up (揃える)
hold down (押さえる) / restrain, suppress (抑える)
hold in one's arms; have (problems) (抱える)
cut down on, refrain from (控える)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.13, PDF 95). Book's notes (paraphrased): 控える = ひかえる (refrain from, cut down on); on-yomi コウ as in 控除. 選択肢の言葉: 1 揃えた (揃える), 2 押さえた (押さえる) / 抑えた (抑える), 3 抱えた (抱える). (added, not in book) おさえた is the tempting one because 抑える also means "keep (something) down" — 量を抑える. But the kanji in the sentence is 控, and 控える is the standard word for cutting down on alcohol, salt, going out (外出を控える).

items.q: 携帯電話の登場は、通信機器の新時代を開く画期的な出来事であった。
items.qr: Keitai denwa no toujou wa, tsuushin kiki no shinjidai o hiraku kakkiteki na dekigoto de atta.
items.en: The arrival of the mobile phone was an epoch-making event that opened a new era for communication devices.

opts.en: wrong — 画 read as ガ
wrong — the small っ is missing

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.13, PDF 95). Book's notes (paraphrased): 画期的 = かっきてき (epoch-making). 画 = ガ (画像, 動画) and カク (企画, 区画, 画数); 期 = キ (期日, 初期) and ゴ (最期); 的 = テキ (的確, 知的) and まと (target). (added, not in book) Two steps: 画 is カク here ("marking off" an era), and カク + k-sound → かっ (trap type 3, like 学期 がっき). ガ (1) is the "picture" reading; 4 forgets the 促音.

items.q: 彼は旅行の予定を変更して、その町に留まることにした。
items.qr: Kare wa ryokou no yotei o henkou shite, sono machi ni todomaru koto ni shita.
items.en: He changed his travel plans and decided to stay on in that town.

opts.en: fit in (収まる) / calm down (治まる) / be paid, settle (納まる)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.13–14, PDF 95–96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 留まる = とどまる (stay, remain). 留 = リュウ (留意, 残留, 保留), ル (留守), と(まる／める) (目に留まる = catch one's eye), とど(まる／める) (stay on; 例: went to Vietnam and stayed on there). 選択肢の言葉: 1 溜まる, 3 固まる, 4 収まる / 治まる / 納まる. (added, not in book) 留まる can also be read とまる — but とまる is not an option, and "stay in a town" is とどまる. 溜 (たまる) contains 留, which is why たまる is

items.q: 彼の言っていることは矛盾だらけだ。
items.qr: Kare no itte iru koto wa mujun darake da.
items.en: What he says is full of contradictions.

opts.en: wrong — 盾 is じゅん

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.14, PDF 96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 矛盾 = むじゅん (inconsistency, contradiction). 矛 = ム (in 矛盾) and ほこ (spear); 盾 = ジュン (in 矛盾) and たて (shield). 選択肢の言葉: 1 従順 / 柔順. (added, not in book) The word comes from the Chinese story of a man selling a spear that pierces any shield and a shield no spear can pierce. 矛 looks like 柔 (ジュウ), which explains the じゅう- options.

items.q: 彼女はまだ若いのに、実際の年齢よりも老けて見える。
items.qr: Kanojo wa mada wakai noni, jissai no nenrei yori mo fukete mieru.
items.en: She is still young, yet she looks older than her real age.

opts.en: wrong — 老 is お only in 老いる
wrong — on-yomi ロウ + けて

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.14, PDF 96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 老ける = ふける (get old, look old). 老 = ロウ (老衰, 老朽化, 敬老), ふ(ける), お(いる). 選択肢の言葉: 4 呆けて (呆ける). (added, not in book) 老 has two kun-yomi verbs: 老ける ふける (look older) and 老いる おいる (grow old). The okurigana tells you which: 〜ける → ふける, 〜いる → おいる. おける mixes them.

items.q: 手紙の宛名を書き間違えるのはとても失礼だ。
items.qr: Tegami no atena o kakimachigaeru no wa totemo shitsurei da.
items.en: Writing the address on a letter wrongly is very rude.

opts.en: full name (氏名) / nomination (指名) / mission (使命)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.14, PDF 96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 宛名 = あてな (mailing address). 宛 = あて (宛先); 名 = メイ (名産, 名簿, 名誉), ミョウ (本名), な (あだ名, 名残). 選択肢の言葉: 1 延命, 2 氏名 / 指名 / 使命, 3 あだ名. (added, not in book) 宛 contains 夗 (like 苑 エン), which is why えんめい is offered; あだな is one kana away from あてな. Kun + kun: あて + な.

items.q: 事業の拡張にともなって、新しい従業員を雇うことにした。
items.qr: Jigyou no kakuchou ni tomonatte, atarashii juugyouin o yatou koto ni shita.
items.en: As the business expanded, we decided to hire new employees.

opts.en: come true (叶う) / suit (適う) / match, rival (敵う)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.14, PDF 96). Book's notes (paraphrased): 雇う = やとう (hire); on-yomi コ as in 雇用, 解雇. 選択肢の言葉: 2 賄う, 3 叶う / 適う / 敵う, 4 慕う. (added, not in book) All four are 〜う verbs of three kana. まかなう is tempting in a business sentence (人件費を賄う "cover staff costs"), but its kanji is 賄. 雇 has 戸 on top — think "bring someone in through the door".

items.q: 昨夜は友人とお洒落なレストランで食事をした。
items.qr: Sakuya wa yuujin to oshare na resutoran de shokuji o shita.
items.en: Last night I had dinner with a friend at a stylish restaurant.

opts.en: not a word (洒 read like 酒 さけ)
not a word (洒 read like 酒 シュ)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.15, PDF 97). Book's notes (paraphrased): 洒落 = しゃれ (stylishness, fashionableness). 洒 = シャ (in 洒落); 落 = ラク (落選, 落下, 集落) and お(ちる／とす). The 別冊 marks「しゃれ」as an exceptional reading. (added, not in book) 洒 differs from 酒 (さけ, シュ) by one stroke — options 1 and 3 are built on that confusion. This word is also on the p.3 list of special readings (trap type 6; see 第1回).

items.q: 早いもので、この制度が発足して10年になる。
items.qr: Hayai mono de, kono seido ga hossoku shite juunen ni naru.
items.en: Time flies — it's already ten years since this system was launched.

opts.en: not a word (wrong on-yomi, no っ)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.15, PDF 97). Book's notes (paraphrased): 発足 = ほっそく (start, set out). 発 = ハツ／パツ (発育, 開発, 反発) and ホツ (発起人 ほっきにん, 発作 ほっさ, 発端 ほったん); 足 = ソク (補足), あし, た(る／りる／す). 選択肢の言葉: 3 補足. (added, not in book) Two traps at once: 発 takes its rarer reading ホツ, and ホツ + s → ほっ (trap type 3). はっそく is also heard nowadays, but it is not an option; the standard reading is ほっそく. ほそく (補足) differs only by the

items.q: 手土産を携えて上司の家を訪問した。
items.qr: Temiyage o tazusaete joushi no ie o houmon shita.
items.en: I visited my boss's home, taking a small gift with me.

opts.en: preparing for; offering (備える・供える)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.15, PDF 97). Book's notes (paraphrased): 携える = たずさえる (carry, take along); 携わる = たずさわる (be engaged in a field). On-yomi ケイ as in 携帯, 連携. 選択肢の言葉: 1 抱えて (抱える), 3 備えて (備える), 4 求めて (求める). (added, not in book) かかえて is the trap — you might "hold" a gift — but its kanji is 抱. 携帯 (keitai, mobile phone) literally means "something carried", which helps you remember 携 = carry.

items.q: 登山は体力を消耗する。
items.qr: Tozan wa tairyoku o shoumou suru.
items.en: Mountain climbing uses up a lot of stamina.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.15–16, PDF 97–98). Book's notes (paraphrased): 消耗 = しょうもう (be worn out, consume). 消 = ショウ (消去, 消息, 解消), き(える), け(す); 耗 = モウ (消耗) and コウ (心神耗弱). 選択肢の言葉: 1 所望. (added, not in book) A pure long-vowel question (trap type 1): both halves are long — しょう + もう. しょもう is a real word (所望, "wish") but a different one. 消耗品 (しょうもうひん) = consumables.

items.q: ドアの隙間から風が入ってきて寒い。
items.qr: Doa no sukima kara kaze ga haitte kite samui.
items.en: Wind is coming in through the gap in the door, and it's cold.

opts.en: not a word (both on-yomi, wrong order of 間隙)

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.16, PDF 98). Book's notes (paraphrased): 隙間 = すきま (space, crack, gap). 隙 = ゲキ (間隙 かんげき) and すき (an opening, a chance); 間 = カン (間隔, 民間), ケン (世間), あいだ, ま (間に合う, 間取り). (added, not in book) Kun + kun: すき + ま. The on-yomi compound with the same kanji is 間隙 かんげき (reverse order) — option 2 tries to trick you with it.

items.q: 我々の連勝を阻む強敵が現れた。
items.qr: Wareware no renshou o habamu kyouteki ga arawareta.
items.en: A strong rival has appeared who could block our winning streak.
items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.16, PDF 98). Book's notes (paraphrased): 阻む = はばむ (block, prevent); on-yomi ソ as in 阻止, 阻害. 選択肢の言葉: 1 拒む, 3 危ぶむ, 4 慎む. (added, not in book) こばむ is the trap: same 〜ばむ ending and a related meaning ("refuse" vs "block"). 拒む = say no to something (要求を拒む); 阻む = physically or figuratively stop progress (行く手を阻む). 慎む was tested in 第3回 Q17.

items.q: 彼は面倒見（めんどうみ）がいいので、大勢の後輩に慕われている。
items.qr: Kare wa mendoumi ga ii node, oozei no kouhai ni shitawarete iru.
items.en: He takes good care of people, so many juniors look up to him.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.16, PDF 98). Book's notes (paraphrased): 慕う = したう (like, adore, be attached to); on-yomi ボ as in 慕情, 思慕. 選択肢の言葉: 1 構われて (構う), 2 担われて (担う), 4 思われて (思う). (added, not in book) 慕う appeared as a distractor in 第6回 Q32 (募る) — now it's the answer. 慕 has 心 (⺗) at the bottom: a feeling. All four options are passive 〜われて forms, so only the kanji decides.

items.q: 彼女は炊事があまり好きではない。
items.qr: Kanojo wa suiji ga amari suki de wa nai.
items.en: She doesn't much like cooking.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.16–17, PDF 98–99). Book's notes (paraphrased): 炊事 = すいじ (cooking). 炊 = スイ (炊飯器, 自炊) and た(く) (cook rice); 事 = ジ (事業, 事前), ズ (好事家), こと (事柄). 選択肢の言葉: 1 託児, 3 火事 / 家事. (added, not in book) 炊 = 火 + 欠, so 火事 (かじ) is the visual trap, and 家事 (housework) is the meaning trap. たくじ plays on the kun-yomi た(く).

items.q: 両親の期待に背いてしまって、無念だ。
items.qr: Ryoushin no kitai ni somuite shimatte, munen da.
items.en: I regret that I let my parents' expectations down.

opts.en: wrong — on-yomi ハイ + verb ending
not a word (背 read like 北 ホク)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.17, PDF 99). Book's notes (paraphrased): 背く = そむく (disobey, go against); 背ける = そむける (turn away: 目を背ける). 背 also = ハイ (背景, 背後) and せ／せい (背が高い). 選択肢の言葉: 2 急いて (急く), with the proverb 急いては事を仕損じる ("haste makes waste"). (added, not in book) せいて is tempting because せ is a real reading of 背 — but せ means "back / height", not a verb. 背 contains 北 (ホク), the source of option 3.

items.q: 政治家のスキャンダルが暴露された。
items.qr: Seijika no sukyandaru ga bakuro sareta.
items.en: The politician's scandal was exposed.

opts.en: wrong — 暴 is バク here

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.17, PDF 99). Book's notes (paraphrased): 暴露 = ばくろ (disclose, expose). 暴 = ボウ (暴動, 暴力, 暴落), バク (only in 暴露), あば(く) (expose), あば(れる) (run wild); 露 = ロ (露骨, 露出), ロウ (披露), つゆ (dew). (added, not in book) ぼうろ is the trap: ボウ is 暴's usual reading. Remember the pair: 暴く (あばく, expose) and 暴露 (ばくろ, exposure) share the "expose" meaning and the rarer readings.

items.q: この小説は主人公の心の闇を描いている。
items.qr: Kono shousetsu wa shujinkou no kokoro no yami o egaite iru.
items.en: This novel depicts the darkness in the main character's heart.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.17, PDF 99). Book's notes (paraphrased): 闇 = やみ (darkness); 暗闇 (くらやみ) = darkness — 例: sitting still in the dark during a power cut. 選択肢の言葉: 1 音, 2 門 / 問 / 紋, 4 問い. (added, not in book) 闇 = 門 + 音, and every distractor is a reading of one of those parts (おと = 音, もん = 門, とい = 問 with 門 around 口). Learn 闇 as one picture: "a sound behind a gate — you can't see".

items.q: 高齢化社会をむかえ、介護サービスを提供する事業が増えている。
items.qr: Koureika shakai o mukae, kaigo saabisu o teikyou suru jigyou ga fuete iru.
items.en: With the arrival of an ageing society, businesses offering care services are increasing.

opts.en: feelings (感情) / bill (勘定) / ring-shaped (環状)
venue (会場) / at sea (海上) / opening (開場) / upstairs (階上)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.17–18, PDF 99–100). Book's notes (paraphrased): 介護 = かいご (looking after the daily life of elderly or sick people). 介 = カイ (介入, 介在, 介抱, 仲介); 護 = ゴ (護衛, 看護, 弁護, 保護) and まも(る). 選択肢の言葉: 1 看護, 3 感情 / 勘定 / 環状, 4 会場 / 海上 / 開場 / 階上. (added, not in book) かんご (看護) is the closest trap: 看護 = medical nursing (看護師 = nurse); 介護 = everyday care (介護士 = care worker). 護 is short ご — not ごう or じょう.

items.q: 講義の要旨をまとめたものを配りますので、よく読んでおくこと。
items.qr: Kougi no youshi o matometa mono o kubarimasu node, yoku yonde oku koto.
items.en: I'll hand out a summary of the lecture's main points — read it carefully.

opts.en: guidelines (要項・要綱) / sunlight (陽光) / going abroad (洋行)

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.18, PDF 100). Book's notes (paraphrased): 要旨 = ようし (summary). 要 = ヨウ (要因, 要請, 概要) and い(る); 旨 = シ (趣旨, 主旨) and むね (the gist: …旨を伝える). 選択肢の言葉: 1 幼児 / 用事, 3 要件 / 用件, 4 要項 / 要綱 / 陽光 / 洋行. (added, not in book) Trap type 2: 旨 is unvoiced シ — ようじ is a different word. 要件 / 要項 also start with 要 and are about documents, which makes 3 and 4 tempting.

items.q: この薬は胃腸の調子を整えてくれる。
items.qr: Kono kusuri wa ichou no choushi o totonoete kureru.
items.en: This medicine puts your stomach and bowels in good order.
items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.18, PDF 100). Book's notes (paraphrased): 整える = ととのえる (put in good shape); 整う = ととのう (be ready). On-yomi セイ as in 整列, 整然, 調整. 選択肢の言葉: 1 そびえて (そびえる), 2 抱えて (抱える), 3 振り替えて (振り替える). (added, not in book) All four end in 〜えて. 調子を整える (get into good condition), 準備が整う (preparations are complete) and 身なりを整える (tidy one's appearance) are the key collocations. 調整 (ちょうせい) has the same meaning in

items.q: 大地震による被災者の数は10万人を超えた。
items.qr: Daijishin ni yoru hisaisha no kazu wa juuman-nin o koeta.
items.en: The number of people affected by the great earthquake has passed 100,000.

opts.en: not a word (被 read like 皮 かわ)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.18–19, PDF 100–101). Book's notes (paraphrased): 被災者 = ひさいしゃ (disaster victims). 被 = ヒ (被災, 被告) and こうむ(る) (suffer); 災 = サイ (災害, 火災, 天災) and わざわ(い); 者 = シャ (科学者, 当事者) and もの (うっかり者, 怠け者). 選択肢の言葉: 1 被害者, 2 負債者. (added, not in book) ひがいしゃ is the strongest trap — real word, same 被, same meaning area. But the kanji here is 災 (サイ, disaster), not 害 (ガイ, harm). 被 contains 皮 (かわ) — the sour

items.q: 博士はノーベル賞の受賞によって世界的な名声を獲得した。
items.qr: Hakase wa Nooberu-shou no jushou ni yotte sekaiteki na meisei o kakutoku shita.
items.en: By winning the Nobel Prize, the doctor gained worldwide fame.

opts.en: mastering (修得・習得) / finding lost property (拾得)
wrong — no 促音 in 獲得

items.why: Answer 2 (別冊 p.19, PDF 101). Book's notes (paraphrased): 獲得 = かくとく (earn, obtain). 獲 = カク (捕獲) and え (獲物); 得 = トク (得点, 所得, 説得, 取得, 習得), え(る), う(る). 選択肢の言葉: 1 如く, 3 修得 / 拾得 / 習得. (added, not in book) Trap type 3 does not apply here: カク / ク shrinks to っ mainly before a k-sound (画期的 かっきてき, 学期 がっき); before t it normally stays く (獲得 かくとく, 確定 かくてい), so かっとく is wrong. しゅうとく words are real but mean "learn

items.q: 船は左に舵を取った。
items.qr: Fune wa hidari ni kaji o totta.
items.en: The ship steered to the left.

opts.en: on-yomi of 舵 (only in compounds like 方向舵)
reading of 蛇 (snake), not 舵

items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.19, PDF 101). Book's notes (paraphrased): 舵 = かじ (steering of a boat); on-yomi ダ as in 方向舵 (rudder). 例: a teacher's job is to "steer" (舵を取る) students so they learn efficiently. 選択肢の言葉: 2 and 4 = 蛇. (added, not in book) 舵 = 舟 (boat) + 它, and 蛇 = 虫 + 它 — same right-hand part, which is where じゃ / へび come from. Alone, 舵 is kun-yomi かじ.

items.q: 審判の判定に選手が異議を唱えることはできない。
items.qr: Shinpan no hantei ni senshu ga igi o tonaeru koto wa dekinai.
items.en: Players cannot raise objections to the referee's decision.

opts.en: restrain (抑える) / hold down (押さえる)

items.why: Answer 1 (別冊 p.19, PDF 101). Book's notes (paraphrased): 唱える = となえる (object, advocate, chant); on-yomi ショウ as in 唱歌, 提唱, 合唱. 選択肢の言葉: 2 称える, 3 抑える / 押さえる, 4 栄える. (added, not in book) All four are 〜える verbs. Key collocations: 異議を唱える (raise an objection), 説を唱える (advocate a theory), 念仏を唱える (chant a prayer). 栄える was in 第5回 Q30's kanji block.

items.q: お金を賭けてゲームをしてはいけません。
items.qr: Okane o kakete geemu o shite wa ikemasen.
items.en: You must not play games betting money.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.19–20, PDF 101–102). Book's notes (paraphrased): 賭ける = かける (gamble, bet); on-yomi ト as in 賭博; 賭け = a bet, 賭け事 = gambling. 選択肢の言葉: 1 儲けて (儲ける), 2 預けて (預ける), 4 避けて (避ける). (added, not in book) 賭 has 貝 (money), like 儲 and 預 have money meanings — that's why もうけて and あずけて are offered. かける has many kanji (掛ける, 駆ける, 欠ける, 賭ける); 命を賭ける = risk one's life.

items.q: どんなに素晴らしい薬でも万人に効くとは限らない。
items.qr: Donna ni subarashii kusuri demo bannin ni kiku to wa kagiranai.
items.en: However wonderful a medicine is, it doesn't necessarily work for everyone.
items.why: Answer 3 (別冊 p.20, PDF 102). Book's notes (paraphrased): 万人 = ばんにん (everyone). 万 = マン (万病, 巨万) and バン (万能, 万国); 人 = ジン (人格, 新人), ニン (人気, 証人), ひと (人柄, 人質), plus exceptional readings (玄人, 素人, 仲人, 若人, 大人, 一人, 二人). (added, not in book) Trap type 5 on both kanji. 万 = バン when it means "all" (万能, 万国, 万全); マン for the number 10,000 (一万). まんにん also exists in some dictionaries, but it is not an option — ばんにん

items.q: S社からの申し出を承諾することが会議で決定された。
items.qr: Esu-sha kara no moushide o shoudaku suru koto ga kaigi de kettei sareta.
items.en: The meeting decided to accept the offer from Company S.

opts.en: not a word (諾 read like 若 ジャク)

items.why: Answer 4 (別冊 p.20, PDF 102). Book's notes (paraphrased): 承諾 = しょうだく (approval, acceptance). 承 = ショウ (承知, 承認, 了承) and うけたまわ(る) (humble: receive, hear); 諾 = ダク (快諾, 受諾, 唯々諾々). 選択肢の言葉: 1 承認 / 証人, 2 承知. (added, not in book) 承認 and 承知 have the same first kanji and similar meanings, so knowing 諾 = ダク is what decides it. 諾 = 言 + 若, which explains the trap じゃく (若 = ジャク).
